subject: Human Body
title: Jejunum and Ileum
description: Learn Jejunum and Ileum in one minute.

hook.text: The small intestine has three sections. The jejunum and ileum do the heavy lifting of absorption.

buildup.text: The jejunum absorbs most carbohydrates, proteins, and fats. It has the densest concentration of villi.

discovery.text: The ileum specializes in vitamin B12 and bile salt recovery. It recycles bile so the liver doesn't remake it all.

twist.text: Lose the ileum to surgery, and B12 deficiency follows. No other section can absorb this critical vitamin.

climax.text: Each section has a specialty. The jejunum grabs the bulk; the ileum rescues what would otherwise be lost.

punchline.text: Two sections, one absorbs food, the other recycles bile.

quiz.question: What is the ileum specialized in absorbing?
